Seanz 9/22/2025 6:33 PM
1.) Dorm - do I actually trust this guy or does he just have a hot voice? I honestly probably have placed an unhealthy level of trust in him, but I'm still being slightly cautious (for now). But also if he's misting me, I've bought into it. Dorm is really fucking chill, he's challenging any preconceived notion I had of him being abrasive (for some reason?) and just generally seems like a really nice fellow who matches my energy in a lot of ways. He went hard as fuck with me on the first challenge, told me he wanted to work with me on day 1, pledged to help me get to my Mom in this game, and this morning told me he literally daydreamed about making f3 with me. We're in what I assume is the first alliance of the season, or very least one of the earlies, and I'm really looking forward to playing the rest of this game with him. 2.) Derek - I fucking love Derek lmao. At last night's jackbox he actually had me in tears, and having the balls to ask for to be added is so fucking funny. He showed a lot of interest in working with me early on, which I appreciate it? He also clearly has played these before, like, many times if I had to guess. He's thinking in the high level social strategy ways, which is typically something I want to be the only one doing. But I'm trying to learn from my past mistakes of clearing out every other threat. Maybe Derek can be a shield, since that's apparently something good players look for. Regardless, fantastic first impressions I fuck w this divo heavy. 3.) Leif - endearing entity Leif is a really interesting case. Very weird individual (complimentary) who I bonded over the weird shit w very quickly. She's really cool, I adore her art style and her humor. She wanted to work with me very early on, and went as far to make the main moves in establishing #sexy-rats. I think she could possibly have a tweaker gene, but that's fine, so do I. Apparently she told Ebb that she liked me unprompted, which is a good sign! They could def be fun to work with in this game. 4.) Ebb - oh definitely a tweaker but he's chill Ebb was the absolute fastest in telling me he wanted to work with me, and frankly it was so fast that idk why he did? But it's fine, because clearly he trusts me completely LMAO. He seemed to be the most enthusiastic about #y-a-o-i and started immediately spilling the beans there. Which prompted me to spill the beans, oops. We've bonded over clowns which is a near unbreakable bond for me (sorry again mylo) usually. My only concern is that he seems to be overplaying a tad bit, but that could possibly be another layer of protection for me. The overplayer you know may be better than the overplayer you don't. 5.) Volume - ouhhhh turn it up Omg I actually love this guy. He's doing a play-by-post grinch themed roleplaying game with me in my 1 on 1s like are you fucking kidding thats incredible. Volume is another person who told me they like my vibe and want to work with me (which is happening a lot so that's nice? i think?) and as established I like his energy too. he's also very clearly very good at these things, so I wouldn't mind him on my side lol. the only issue being that, he doesn't seem to be talking to a lot of people and he didn't do too much in the challenge, so it would be hard for me to stick my neck out for him if he became a target. But I like him a lot, I'd love to keep him around and play w him if possible. 6.) Muski - she's literally KawaiiMuski she's literally KawaiiMuski. i was wildly excited to play with Muski, and then she kind of quashed that with the day 1 drunk VC thing but then she immediately redeemed herself two days in a row! she is an icon and a legend for a reason, but also! she is one of the only people who has not directly told me they want to work with me lmao. she's also a social POWERHOUSE which is a bit of a threat. but i adore her so bad
6:35 PM
so i'd like to find a timeline where we get to make a deep run together. #sexy-rats does feel like a potential powerhouse alliance if we all remain loyal to it.
